candidates.review_note: The 94 paired profiles are single-cell RNA-seq and T-cell-receptor sequencing rather than direct whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq. Clinical response associations do not alter the assay ineligibility.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / advanced gastric-cancer chemoimmunotherapy study

candidates.review_note: All 33 one-patient/one-tumor profiles have positive source-provided OS duration and explicit death status. GEO does not define the endpoint time origin, follow-up is heterogeneous and only seven deaths are observed; those limitations remain visible. The release freezes 36,134 HUGO-mapped genes and excludes unknown or repeated symbols.

The study provides direct bulk RNA-seq for 80 early-onset gastric tumors plus 80 matched adjacent tissues. Its public clinical table is aggregate, and the patient-level subtype and multi-omic workbooks omit individual survival time/status.

The release contains 18 baseline and six on-treatment gastric-tumor-derived RNA profiles from trastuzumab-deruxtecan studies. GEO publishes subject and time-point identifiers only, while the official article supplement reports aggregate patient characteristics and response analyses without individual OS or PFS duration and event/censor status.

Whole-transcriptome sequencing covers all 26 patients across 55 normal, primary and metastatic profiles, and the article reports a 19.3-month cohort median survival. Supplementary Data 1 contains clinicopathologic attributes but no individual follow-up or event. The public survival notebook reads an untracked data/Survival.tsv; the file was never present in git history and the Zenodo archive contains code only.

The phase-I solid-tumor study sequences T-cell-receptor repertoires in tumor biopsies and PBMC subsets before and after anti-CD4 treatment. It is not gene-level bulk RNA expression, and the small gastrointestinal cohort is not deterministically separable into gastric versus pancreatic primary cancers.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / IT1208 phase-I TCR-seq study

candidates.review_note: The release contains paired 10x single-cell gene-expression and T-cell-receptor libraries from circulating PBMCs of six advanced-gastric-cancer patients. It is neither direct bulk tumor RNA-seq nor a whole-tumor expression cohort.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / gastric-cancer PBMC single-cell study

candidates.review_note: The 19 profiles mix normal tissues and paired pre/post biopsies from several advanced solid-tumor primaries. The gastric-cancer subset contains only four tumors, with four additional gastroesophageal cases, and the assay is 3-prime SAGE rather than a disease-matched survival cohort.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / IT1208 phase-I mixed-solid-tumor study

candidates.review_note: Thirteen direct gastric tumors have age, sex, TN stage, EMVI score and a PFS-time field, but no event/censor indicator. The local cohort was used for EMVI differential expression, while survival modeling used TCGA. Even treating the three values below 12 months as unverified events would remain below the five-event minimum.
Twelve profiles are primary tumor, normal mucosa and ovarian-metastasis triplets from only four patients. The cohort is below the ten-patient minimum.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / paired gastric-primary and ovarian-metastasis study

candidates.review_note: The mixed multi-assay release is dominated by cell-line ecDNA experiments and contains no gastric-cancer patient cohort. Two tissue labels refer to prostate cancer, confirming the STAD search hit as a disease mismatch.
The accession is a single-cell RNA-seq gastric-cancer and normal-tissue reanalysis, not direct whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / gastric-cancer single-cell T-cell landscape

candidates.review_note: Seventeen direct gastric tumors are labeled by presence or absence of peritoneal metastasis, but neither GEO nor the source article releases exact individual endpoint time/status for these profiles. Survival analyses use larger clinical, TCGA or GSE62254 cohorts rather than this local RNA-seq release.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO and Europe PMC / gastric peritoneal-metastasis diagnostic study

candidates.review_note: All libraries are AGS or GES gastric cell-line experiments under Helicobacter pylori or epigenetic perturbations. No direct patient tumors are present.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / gastric cell-line histone-lactylation study

candidates.review_note: The series contains RNA-seq and MeRIP-seq from paired gastric cancer and adjacent tissue in only three patients. The patient count is below ten.

The 22 profiles are matched normal and cancer-associated fibroblast cultures from 11 diffuse gastric-cancer patients rather than direct whole-tumor aliquots. No exact endpoint is linked to the fibroblast profiles.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / diffuse gastric-cancer fibroblast study

candidates.review_note: All nine source-defined TGCT patients map deterministically through RNASEQ_SAMPLE_ID to the public 58,288-row TPM matrix and have exact OS, but the subset is below the ten-patient minimum and contains no censored observations.
candidates.source: META-PRISM / Gustave Roussy cBioPortal and public data release

candidates.review_note: The complete POG570 continuous mRNA profile contains one non-seminomatous germ-cell-tumor patient with exact OS. The disease-matched subset is far below the patient, event and censoring thresholds.
The complete public PCAWG expression inventory and linked clinical tables were screened by disease label. No TGCT patient has a profile in the 1,209-sample expression matrix.
The often-cited 101-tumor cohort was measured on Affymetrix U133A and U133B microarrays, not by RNA-seq. It therefore cannot satisfy the direct bulk RNA-seq contract.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / adult male germ-cell-tumor expression cohort

candidates.review_note: The validation set has clinical follow-up for 34 non-seminoma germ-cell tumors, but each tumor was hybridized to Affymetrix U133A and U133B arrays. A later paper describes these GEO cohorts as RNA sequencing, contrary to the official assay records.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / germ-cell-tumor outcome validation set

candidates.review_note: Relapse labels are available, but expression was measured on an Illumina HumanHT-12 array rather than by RNA-seq.

The cohort has follow-up for 35 pure seminoma patients, but tumor-front and tumor-center expression was measured with the targeted NanoString nCounter PanCancer Progression Panel of 770 genes rather than whole-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq. Raw values are additionally available only from the authors on request.
candidates.source: British Journal of Cancer / Cologne seminoma cohort

candidates.review_note: The public transcriptome matrix contains five TGCT cell-line conditions (NCCIT and NTERA-2 derivatives), not the 31 primary tumors. The patient cohort was profiled genomically, and its individual data are available only by request.
The ENA project and its BioStudies/ArrayExpress alias contain RNA-seq from only two chemotherapy-resistant TGCT patients.

The 26-library RNA-seq experiment contains only four direct testicular germ-cell tumors; the remaining libraries are cell lines or other tumor entities. No individual time-to-event endpoint is published, so it also fails endpoint eligibility.
The 26 tumor profiles were generated on an Illumina HumanHT-12 v4 expression array.
The fourteen GDC germ-cell diagnoses are intracranial pediatric brain tumors rather than testicular germ-cell tumors, and usable individual follow-up is absent.
The cisplatin-sensitivity experiment profiles TGCT cell lines and their resistant derivatives rather than patient tumors.

All RNA-seq libraries are drug-treatment or KDM6A/KDM6B perturbation experiments in cisplatin-sensitive NT2/D1-A4 and resistant 2102EP-C1 testicular-germ-cell-tumor cell lines. The series contains no direct patient-tumor profiles or linked clinical endpoint.

The mRNA subseries contains paired tumor and adjacent-tissue profiles from only seven testicular-germ-cell-tumor patients. GSE31617 is the superseries containing the same specimens, not an independent cohort; neither release provides an eligible ten-patient time-to-event series.

The 43 FFPE profiles from 32 patients were generated by miRNA-seq and quantify 2,606 microRNAs rather than whole-transcriptome bulk mRNA expression. The study therefore falls outside the repository assay and gene-coverage contract.
All libraries derive from 2102EP and TCam-2 cell-line experiments, with no patient tumors or time-to-event outcomes.

Primary seminoma specimens were profiled by single-cell and multiome assays rather than direct bulk RNA-seq. The bulk RNA-seq libraries in the series are iPSC/PGCLC model-cell experiments, not patient tumors.
The 2026 RNA-seq series contains six RBMXL3 perturbation libraries from the TCam-2 seminoma cell line, not direct patient tumors or linked outcomes.
Both RNA-seq libraries are DDX53 perturbation experiments in the TCam-2 seminoma cell line; no patient tumor or clinical endpoint is present.

The tumor-linked libraries profile ex vivo cultured cancer-associated fibroblasts isolated from fourteen germ-cell tumors rather than direct bulk tumor RNA. Five additional libraries are non-malignant fibroblast cultures, and no time-to-event endpoint is released.

The only seminoma specimens are three FFPE H3K4me2 FiT-seq/ChIP-seq profiles. RNA-seq in the mixed-tumor series is restricted to colorectal specimens, so TGCT fails both the direct bulk-RNA and patient-count criteria.

The mixed-species PFAS experiment profiles human germ-cell-tumor cell lines and mouse testis rather than direct human patient tumors. It contains no disease-matched patient cohort or linked time-to-event endpoint.
The RNA-seq libraries are treatment and differentiation experiments in TCam-2 and NTera2 testicular germ-cell-tumor cell lines. No patient tumor or individual clinical endpoint is present.

The two independent MSK germ-cell-tumor studies contain 180 and 21 patients, respectively, but their public cBioPortal molecular profiles are limited to mutation, copy-number and structural-variant data; neither study exposes RNA expression.

This is single-cell RNA-seq of testicular somatic cells from one person with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome plus reanalysis of non-cancer infertility datasets. It contains no direct bulk testicular germ-cell tumor cohort or linked time-to-event endpoint.

HRA004398 contains open 10x Visium spatial transcriptomes from only three seminoma patients. The article's prognostic bulk analyses are TCGA-derived, and all five official supplements omit an independent patient-level bulk RNA expression and survival table.
candidates.source: GSA-Human / British Journal of Cancer seminoma study

candidates.review_note: Despite its tumor-focused title, the complete RNA-seq series consists of MIR9-2 perturbation experiments in NTERA-2 and TCam-2 cell lines. It contains no direct patient-tumor transcriptomes or linked time-to-event endpoint.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / MIR9-2 testicular germ-cell-tumor study

candidates.review_note: The six pure seminomas and six mixed testicular germ-cell tumors were measured by expression microarray rather than direct bulk RNA-seq.
The refractory testicular germ-cell-tumor series is genome-variation profiling by array with whole-exome sequencing, not an RNA-expression experiment.

The study sequenced thirteen local TGCT tumors, but it does not deposit their complete expression matrix or individual follow-up. Its prognostic Cox and Kaplan-Meier analyses use 134 TCGA-TGCT cases, so they cannot form an independent external release.
candidates.source: Frontiers in Endocrinology / Xiangya TGCT study

candidates.review_note: The controlled-access pediatric pan-solid-tumor project includes ten germ-cell-tumor models among sixteen disease groups, but its RNA-seq inventory is predominantly patient-derived xenografts and does not define a disease-matched testicular primary-tumor survival cohort. Controlled access and the absent eligible endpoint are additional independent failures.
candidates.source: European Genome-phenome Archive / pediatric solid-tumor PDX study

candidates.review_note: The local 36-patient cohort was evaluated by tissue-microarray immunohistochemistry, while transcriptomic clinical associations came from TCGA-TGCT. RNA-seq and ATAC-seq were CHD1L perturbation experiments in testicular-cancer cell lines, not direct patient-tumor profiles with independent follow-up.
candidates.source: Scientific Reports / Renji Hospital TGCT study

candidates.review_note: The local experiment sequenced thirteen testicular-germ-cell tumors and four adjacent tissues, but it does not release individual survival or recurrence time/status linked to those profiles. Prognostic analyses in the article use TCGA/GEPIA rather than an independent local endpoint cohort.
candidates.source: Cell Death Discovery / local TGCT cohort

candidates.review_note: The twelve TGCT biosamples were profiled by small-RNA sequencing for miRNA, piRNA and tRNA-derived fragments rather than whole-transcriptome bulk mRNA RNA-seq, so the study cannot meet the 10,000-gene expression contract.

The public FFPE series contains 31 primary and 12 metastatic TGCT specimens from 29 patients, but it profiles 2,606 microRNAs rather than whole-transcriptome mRNA. No individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status is linked to the profiles.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / primary and metastatic TGCT miRNA study

candidates.review_note: The preliminary BITCOIN analysis reports 27 QC-passing FFPE RNA-seq specimens from 19 bilateral-TGCT patients, but the meeting abstract provides neither a public expression accession nor individual survival or recurrence time/status. It therefore cannot form a reusable time-to-event cohort.

Thirty chemotherapy-naive and twenty post-chemotherapy viable germ-cell tumors were profiled from FFPE tissue with the targeted HTG EdgeSeq Oncology Biomarker Panel rather than whole-transcriptome RNA-seq. The meeting abstract also releases neither a full expression matrix nor individual time-to-event records.

The NCTN archive publishes one-row-per-patient EFS and OS clinical data for pediatric and adolescent germ-cell tumors, but no matched tumor bulk RNA-seq matrix or molecular accession is part of the release. Clinical follow-up alone cannot satisfy the expression-plus-endpoint contract.

Five public MET500 RNA libraries collapse to three deterministic TGCT patients, below the ten-patient minimum. The public UCSC Xena phenotype matrix contains no exact individual endpoint duration or event/censor indicator; richer participant attributes remain permission-gated in dbGaP.

Treehouse contains only one non-TCGA PolyA donor and one RiboD donor explicitly labelled testicular germ-cell tumor; generic pediatric germ-cell labels cannot establish a testicular primary and no exact endpoint is public. The current GDC target cohort is TCGA-derived, while Hartwig and PedcBioPortal require controlled or authenticated access. No eligible external TGCT cohort was recovered.
candidates.source: Treehouse / St. Jude Cloud / NCI GDC / Hartwig / PedcBioPortal

candidates.review_note: Kids First reports RNA sequencing for a mixed extracranial germ-cell-tumor study of 393 children and young adults. Quantified expression requires portal registration and accepted data-use terms, while subject-level genomic files require dbGaP approval. The anonymous study pages do not establish a testicular-primary subset linked to exact individual survival or recurrence time/status, so no publicly reusable TCGA-TGCT replication bundle can be constructed.
candidates.source: Gabriella Miller Kids First DRC / dbGaP

candidates.review_note: The complete participant-level GraphQL audit found one testis-site yolk-sac-tumor participant with RNA-seq files in phs002529. The files are controlled, the subset has only one patient, and no public exact individual time/status endpoint is exposed. It cannot close the TGCT evidence gap.

The DDBJ GEA record profiles NT2 human embryonal-carcinoma cells during induced neuronal differentiation. These are cell-line array experiments rather than direct testicular germ-cell-tumor specimens, and no patient-level time-to-event cohort is present.
candidates.source: DDBJ Genomic Expression Archive / NT2 differentiation study

cancers.review_note: No independent public bulk RNA-seq cohort with linked time-to-event data and enough events was identified after GEO, ENA/SRA, BioStudies, cBioPortal, GDC, OmicsDI, MET500, Treehouse, St. Jude Cloud, Hartwig, PedcBioPortal and recent-publication review. Available RNA-seq cohorts are cell-line studies, too small, TCGA duplicates, controlled or omit individual outcome time/status.

candidates.review_note: The source-defined non-TCGA thyroid subset contains nine medullary thyroid carcinomas and one poorly differentiated thyroid carcinoma. All ten patients map one-to-one through RNASEQ_SAMPLE_ID to public GENCODE-v27 TPM and exact OS. The pinned bundle passed repository QC with 56,356 unambiguous complete symbols; it is explicitly labeled as an advanced-disease histology expansion rather than a papillary TCGA replication cohort.
candidates.source: META-PRISM / Gustave Roussy cBioPortal and public data release

candidates.review_note: Five public MET500 RNA libraries collapse to four deterministic thyroid-cancer patients, below the ten-patient minimum. The public UCSC Xena phenotype matrix contains no exact individual endpoint duration or event/censor indicator; richer participant attributes remain permission-gated in dbGaP.
All twenty libraries are control, IFT57-knockout or CD47-knockout replicates of the 8505C anaplastic-thyroid-carcinoma cell line. No direct patient tumor cohort is present.
The cohort consists of melanoma tumors treated in an anti-PD-L1 study. It appeared in thyroid/MAPK-oriented discovery results but contains no thyroid carcinoma samples.

The PRECISE supplement publishes exact PFS for eleven tumors, and GEO SOFT explicitly maps each one through its Sample N identifier. A separate endpoint-rescue audit covered the 111-patient TDS survival paper (PMCID:PMC11747754), its complete Figshare table supplement (DOI:10.6084/m9.figshare.26314564.v1), and the 2026 xTDS paper (DOI:10.1200/PO-26-00207). Those sources report cohort-level PFI, OS or DSS analyses but release only aggregate model tables and explicitly restrict generated patient data. GSE310793 contains 109 expression profiles, so the other 98 remain excluded for lack of public individual time/status.

The Vanderbilt/Washington study profiled 312 thyroid tumors from 251 patients and reports individual-level outcome analyses; PRECISE later used 65 Vanderbilt PTC cases as validation. The publication states that patient clinical and sequencing data are stored in a secure Vanderbilt system and are available only through approved collaboration. Neither the full expression matrix nor linked patient-level time/status is publicly reusable.

A source-level re-audit found 24 direct ATC tumors marked RNASeq-present in Supplementary Table 1 and confirmed all 24 in the whole-transcriptome TPM matrix of Supplementary Table 3. Nineteen have exact overall-survival time/status, with 15 deaths and four censored patients. All status and time fields are missing for ANPT0066P, ANPT0067P, ANPT0069P, ANPT0070P and ANPT0106P, and Supplementary Tables 2-14 add no recoverable outcomes. The series therefore fails only the prespecified minimum of five censored observations.

The public study provides direct PTC RNA-seq and processed StringTie files for 157 patients selected from the high and low radiomic-score groups. Its 2025 Science Advances article reports recurrence counts and a DFS analysis for the larger 255-patient exploratory cohort. However, the current SDRF exposes only sample ID, age, sex and radiomic group, and the complete Data S1-S8 package contains model summaries, differential-expression results and plotted values without individual DFS time/status or a clinical crosswalk. The endpoint therefore cannot be linked to the 157 RNA profiles.

Forty Indian papillary-thyroid-carcinoma FFPE whole-transcriptome libraries are open. The SDRF provides sample identity, age and sex but no event indicator or exact follow-up, survival, recurrence or progression time.

Thirty Indian anaplastic-thyroid-carcinoma FFPE whole-transcriptome libraries are open, but the SDRF contains no individual event indicator or exact follow-up, survival, recurrence or progression time.

The nine direct thyroid-tissue profiles represent only seven individuals: three atypical samples all come from Patient7, alongside three follicular-adenoma and three follicular-carcinoma cases. The study is below the ten-patient floor and does not provide a qualifying individual time-to-event endpoint.

The refractory metastatic differentiated-thyroid-cancer trial series contain 13 and eight samples assayed by HTG targeted hybrid-selection panels rather than direct whole-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq. Public metadata provide response categories but no qualifying individual time-to-event endpoint.

The study reports RNA-seq for 92 papillary-thyroid carcinomas, but the patient-level transcriptomes are deposited under controlled GSA-Human access. Open supplementary files do not contain a complete reusable expression matrix linked to individual follow-up.

The medullary-thyroid-carcinoma study reports 101 RNA-seq profiles and prognostic follow-up, but GSA-Human marks HRA002294 as controlled access. Public supplements expose clinical summaries without a complete reusable patient-level expression matrix linked to exact time/status.

The 2026 metabolic-heterogeneity study reuses the same 101 PRJCA008783 medullary-thyroid-carcinoma RNA profiles. Its public GitHub repository explicitly excludes the primary data and does not create an independent expression-plus-endpoint release.
candidates.source: British Journal of Cancer / PRJCA008783 reanalysis

candidates.review_note: Newly generated transcriptomic data are single-nucleus or spatial assays rather than direct whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq. The whole-transcriptome validation sets reuse TCGA, PRJEB11591, EGAS00001003540 and an earlier secure KHDP release; KHDP is a controlled no-export environment and no new public bulk matrix linked to exact individual time/status is provided.
candidates.source: Molecular Cancer / SNUH thyroid progression study

candidates.review_note: The 113-patient discovery cohort was profiled by proteomics and targeted DNA sequencing, not whole-transcriptome RNA-seq. The transcriptomic validation component comprises single-cell and spatial RNA profiles from ten patients, including three reused from HRA001107, so it is not an eligible direct bulk RNA survival cohort.
candidates.source: Cell Reports Medicine / advanced differentiated thyroid cancer

candidates.review_note: Eight recurrent and eight non-recurrent tumors are labeled. GEO, the article supplement, the released model matrices and source code were audited: they expose only the binary recurrence label and aggregate follow-up/recurrence medians, not individual recurrence or censoring times.
Only eight high-risk follicular-thyroid-cancer patients underwent bulk RNA-seq; the larger prognostic cohort was profiled by immunohistochemistry.

A current GDC API audit found 449 project cases, 906 open STAR-count gene-expression files and 438 distinct cases with expression. The case records expose zero demographic vital-status values, zero days-to-death values, zero diagnosis-level days-to-death values and no follow-up records; only 12 diagnoses contain isolated days-to-last-follow-up values. A valid event/censor endpoint therefore cannot be formed.
RNA-seq is public for 125 sorafenib-trial samples, but neither SRA/BioSample nor the public supplements release individual PFS or OS time/status.
The 92 libraries derive from only nine papillary-thyroid-cancer patients.
The two non-TCGA thyroid projects expose clinical and mutation objects but no open exp_seq objects.
The sample records report all participants alive when data were uploaded, but provide no follow-up duration and therefore no usable censored survival time or events.

The public bulk RNA-seq series contains 97 mRNA profiles, including technical replicates, and the publication supplement reports diagnosis, histology and selected molecular annotations. It does not publish individual survival or recurrence time/status, so no censored endpoint can be reconstructed.

The series provides direct bulk RNA-seq for 348 PTC, five PDTC and sixteen ATC primary tumors. Supplementary Data 13 of the original molecular study links GEO IDs to tissue type, diagnosis year, age and sex. A later 80-patient PTC analysis from this release reports 8.8 years mean follow-up, six structural recurrences and an RFS curve, but its complete public supplement contains only differential-expression, pathway and aggregate clinicopathological tables. Neither publication releases individual recurrence time/status linked to the RNA identifiers, so the endpoint cannot be reconstructed.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / Kim et al. / Ju et al.

candidates.review_note: Ten primary anaplastic-thyroid-carcinoma tumors have direct bulk RNA-seq and a public processed matrix. GEO exposes only tumor subtype and tissue; the original article and both official supplements provide aggregate cohort characteristics and diagnostic-marker tables without individual survival, progression or recurrence time/status. The later 74-ATC integrated analysis retains its associated survival metadata under requested EGA access.
Seventy-one thyroid cases are registered, but no open gene-expression files or usable individual endpoint times are exposed.

Thirteen direct papillary-thyroid-cancer bulk RNA-seq profiles are public. GEO provides age group, sex, focality and invasion category, but the independent cohort has no individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status; survival analyses in the article use TCGA instead.

Sixteen papillary-thyroid-cancer tumors have direct bulk RNA-seq. The official clinical supplement reports only aggregate cohort characteristics and does not link any individual endpoint duration and event/censor indicator to the RNA profiles.

The series contains matched normal, primary-tumor and metastatic-lymph-node profiles from ten papillary-thyroid-cancer patients. GEO exposes age, sex, cT and cN but no individual time-to-event endpoint, and no associated publication supplies one.

Eighteen direct papillary-thyroid-cancer tumor transcriptomes are public. GEO, the article and its official supplements provide diagnostic and molecular annotations but no individual survival, recurrence or progression duration and status.

Twenty direct papillary-thyroid-cancer tumor RNA-seq profiles have age, sex, TNM and BRAF annotations in GEO, but neither the public record nor the molecular-comparison article releases an individual time-to-event endpoint.

GEO exposes a 26,364-gene matrix for fifteen selected thyroid tumors, and the CC BY Figshare workbook provides exact progression/follow-up fields for the parent 106-tumor series. After matching IDs and excluding two benign tumors, two endpoint-missing primaries and two endpoint-missing metastatic specimens, only nine malignant tumors have usable time/status: five events and four censored. The release therefore fails both the ten-patient and five-censored minima.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / Figshare / Landa et al.

candidates.review_note: BioStudies provides a CC0 gene-level mRNA FPKM matrix for 46 tumors that passed RNA QC (31 PTC, ten ATC and five PDTC), plus 23 normal tissues. The repository and Supplementary Table S1 link sample IDs, institutions and histology groups but publish no individual survival, progression or recurrence time/status.

The article reports RNA-seq for forty Hürthle-cell carcinomas and cites PRJNA989587, but NCBI currently marks the BioProject as not public and ENA returns no runs. Public supplements contain aggregate Kaplan-Meier curves and molecular tables rather than a reusable patient-level expression matrix or exact recurrence time/status.
candidates.source: NCBI SRA / Memorial Sloan Kettering Hürthle-cell cohort

candidates.review_note: Eighteen non-classical PTC tumors underwent DNA/RNA sequencing and have reported follow-up, but all eighteen patients were alive without recurrence. The cohort therefore has zero RFS events and cannot satisfy the prespecified minimum of five events, irrespective of expression-file availability.
candidates.source: National Omics Data Encyclopedia / non-classical PTC cohort

candidates.review_note: The study sequenced ten lymph-node-metastatic and ten non-metastatic papillary thyroid microcarcinomas, but HRA011009 is a GSA-Human participant-level deposit rather than an openly reusable expression release. Its published outcome is a cross-sectional lymph-node-metastasis label, not individual time-to-event follow-up.

GEO registers twenty-five direct FFPE thyroid-tumor RNA-seq profiles and releases raw reads plus group-level Cuffdiff summaries. Sample metadata contain treatment, histology, age, sex and genotype but no individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status; RAI sensitivity is a binary phenotype rather than a time-to-event endpoint.

E-MTAB-15198 openly releases 72 sporadic medullary-thyroid-carcinoma transcriptomes, including 20 specimens reused from E-MTAB-11599. Medullary carcinoma is a parafollicular neuroendocrine malignancy outside the papillary follicular-cell disease represented by TCGA-THCA; the SDRF also contains no individual time-to-event endpoint.
candidates.source: EMBL-EBI BioStudies / medullary thyroid carcinoma atlas

candidates.review_note: The study generated whole-transcriptome profiles for 113 PTC patients and OMIX lists expression and clinical files. Despite labeling the release open-access, the repository explicitly marks both files unavailable for download because registration in the Human Genetic Resource Management Platform has not been completed. No reusable expression-plus-endpoint bundle can therefore be obtained.

PRJEB11591 provides direct transcriptomes for 125 PTC patients and PRJNA431763 covers the small local sequencing set. The article's disease-free-survival analysis explicitly uses 493 TCGA-THCA patients; neither external sequencing cohort has individual recurrence or survival time/status linked to its RNA profiles.

Thirty selected differentiated-thyroid tumors underwent local whole-transcriptome sequencing, but the data-availability statement releases only reused TCGA and ENCODE resources. The local matrix and individual time-to-event follow-up are not public; the apparent SYN2 token is a gene name, not a repository accession.

The series contains 39 papillary-thyroid-cancer tissues and 13 normal tissues, but its patient expression experiments are gene-expression microarray and miRNA profiling rather than direct whole-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq.

The study newly RNA-sequenced 25 advanced thyroid tumors and provides individual clinical follow-up in its publication, but participant-level sequencing is deposited under controlled EGA access. The open supplements do not expose the complete expression matrix linked to time and status.
candidates.source: European Genome-Phenome Archive / Seoul advanced thyroid cohort

candidates.review_note: The deposited transcriptomes are PMAIP1 knockdown and control experiments in FTC133 and FTC238 cell lines. The patient expression and prognostic analyses in the article reuse TCGA rather than a newly released direct tumor cohort.
candidates.source: NCBI SRA / PMAIP1 thyroid cell-line study

candidates.review_note: RNA-seq of frozen biopsies was a prespecified correlative objective in this completed lenvatinib-plus-pembrolizumab trial, which reports PFS and OS for 54 treated patients. The primary article does not publish a patient-level expression matrix or cite a GEO, SRA, dbGaP, EGA, CIDC or CTDC molecular accession, and its data-availability statement makes generated data author-request only.

The DDBJ GEA record summarizes 42 papillary carcinomas, 28 follicular carcinomas, 58 follicular adenomas and 40 normal thyroid specimens into five aggregate sample classes. It uses adaptor-tagged competitive PCR and is classified as transcription profiling by array, not patient-level whole-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq; no individual endpoint is released.
candidates.source: DDBJ Genomic Expression Archive / thyroid expression study

candidates.review_note: KCG labels this mixed thyroid-cancer/thymoma project as RNA-seq and lists 444 biosamples, but every biosample on the project page is restricted. The public metadata do not separate an eligible thyroid cohort with exact individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

candidates.review_note: KCG lists 632 restricted biosamples and processed RSEM files. Its project description says refractory thyroid cancer while repository disease metadata label the files as thymoma, so target assignment is internally inconsistent; no open patient-level matrix with an exact time/status endpoint is exposed.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

cancers.review_note: Two independent releases are available: eleven primary papillary thyroid tumors with exact PFS from GSE310793/PRECISE, and ten advanced non-TCGA thyroid cancers with exact OS from META-PRISM. They remain separate because histology, disease setting, endpoint and expression processing differ.

candidates.review_note: Both source-defined THYM patients link to the public META-PRISM TPM matrix and exact OS, but the disease-matched subset has only two patients, one event and one censored observation.
candidates.source: META-PRISM / Gustave Roussy cBioPortal and public data release

candidates.review_note: POG570 contains one thymoma and three thymic-carcinoma patients with continuous mRNA expression and exact OS. The combined thymic-neoplasm subset is below ten patients and has no observed deaths.
The complete public PCAWG expression inventory and linked clinical tables were screened by disease label. No thymic-neoplasm patient has a profile in the 1,209-sample expression matrix.

The pembrolizumab thymic-carcinoma release has ten clinical records but only nine public count-matrix columns. The missing alive patient, PD1-032, has an RNA-labelled GEO record but no public SRA run or count column. Five RNA patients are deceased and four alive, while ClinicalData.xlsx and both primary publications omit individual OS/PFS duration. The source fails both the ten-patient and exact-time requirements.
The thymic-neoplasm cohort has follow-up but uses an Illumina whole-genome expression array.
This is a single-cell atlas with only six thymoma/thymic-carcinoma samples, not a bulk survival cohort.
The HIPO advanced thymic-epithelial-tumor study links transcriptomes and OS, but both RNA-seq datasets are controlled-access and no open processed matrix is released.
Bulk RNA-seq is public for 13 thymic malignancies, but GEO and the article provide histology without individual follow-up time/status.
The 138-case whole-transcriptome cohort has survival analyses, but patient-level expression and outcomes are proprietary and not publicly reusable.
candidates.source: Caris Life Sciences / JCO Precision Oncology

candidates.review_note: GEO exposes 25 bulk transcriptomes. The GEO sample table and every article supplementary/source-data workbook were audited; they provide histology, stage and molecular annotations but no individual survival time/status. The publication's survival analysis used a larger mutation cohort rather than these transcriptomes.
The tumor subset contains eleven thymic carcinoids and two thymomas, with no individual survival endpoint; it is also not a disease-matched thymoma cohort.
The study is a single-cell and spatial transcriptomic atlas rather than an independent bulk RNA-seq survival cohort.
Eleven primary thymic carcinomas have public bulk RNA-seq. The article, SRA/BioSample records and supplements publish age, sex and stage but no individual survival or recurrence time/status.
The 97-patient thymoma cohort links RNA-seq with prognosis, but the official NBDC record classifies the deposit as controlled-access Type I and requires an application.

The independent SNUH thymic-epithelial-tumor RNA-seq cohort is controlled-access. Its open supplement is limited to 2,500 variable genes and cannot satisfy the 10,000-symbol policy. The linked 2026 Cancer Research article (PMID:41671387; PMCID:PMC13012242) and both cited GitHub repositories were re-audited: they expose analysis scripts and figures, not the missing complete patient-level matrix and endpoint table.

Whole-transcriptome RNA-seq from 26 QC-passed Chinese thymic epithelial tumors is described at gene-level FPKM. The article and all four public supplementary files provide patient histology, stage, autoimmune disease, imaging, mutation and pathway annotations, but no individual follow-up time or event status; they also do not expose the complete reusable expression matrix.

The 353-library strand-specific pan-cancer series contains exactly one sample labelled rare_cancer_thymoma. The remaining libraries represent other cancers, benign tissue or cell lines; raw sequence is additionally dbGaP-controlled. The disease-matched subset is therefore below the ten-patient minimum.

The pan-solid-tumor RO7122290 pharmacodynamic series includes paired baseline/treated biopsies from exactly one participant labelled thymoma and thymic carcinoma. It cannot form a ten-patient disease-matched survival cohort.

The pan-cancer vertebral-metastasis RNA-seq series contains exactly one sample assigned to thymoma. The disease-matched subset is below the ten-patient minimum and cannot provide an independent THYM survival cohort.

Thirty primary resected thymic epithelial tumors underwent bulk RNA-seq, but the article performs prognostic analyses using TCGA-THYM and states that the local raw and processed transcriptomes are available only from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
The human thymoma subset contains six tumors and was profiled on an Affymetrix expression array; it therefore fails both the bulk RNA-seq assay and ten-patient criteria.
The 32-patient NCI thymic epithelial tumor study exposes mutation and copy-number profiles in cBioPortal but no RNA-expression profile.

The study profiles isolated thymocytes and tumor epithelial cells with 10x single-cell RNA-seq and paired single-cell TCR-seq. It is not direct bulk tumor RNA-seq and does not release a ten-patient time-to-event cohort.

Although the parent thoracic-cancer protocol allowed thymoma, the authorized-access submission explicitly states that its deposited RNA-seq is focused on non-small-cell lung cancers and adjacent lung. It contains no reusable THYM expression-survival cohort.

The clinical cohorts were assayed by proteomics and immunohistochemistry. The article's RNA-seq experiment compares Galectin-7-overexpressing Tc1889 cells with controls, not direct patient tumors, and therefore cannot supply a bulk THYM survival release.
candidates.source: Translational Oncology / thymic epithelial tumor study

candidates.review_note: Although the series summary discusses an integrated human thymic-epithelial-tumor cohort, the deposited experiment is one single-cell RNA-seq library generated from pooled thymuses of seven FVB mice. It contains no human patient-tumor bulk RNA-seq or linked endpoint.

GEO publicly releases gene-level RPKM for thirteen thymic malignancies plus three normal thymus samples. Tumor metadata contain disease state and WHO subtype only; no individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status is available for the RNA profiles.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / Indiana University thymoma study

candidates.review_note: The institutional RNA-seq cohort includes sixteen thymoma patients with myasthenia gravis and eighteen without it. Myasthenia status is a binary phenotype rather than a time-to-event endpoint, and no public expression matrix with individual survival or recurrence follow-up is exposed.
candidates.source: Lung Cancer / Taichung Veterans General Hospital

candidates.review_note: Ten Japanese thymic carcinomas and paired non-cancer tissues underwent RNA-seq and other genomic assays, but the article provides no public reusable expression matrix or repository accession and no individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status.

The atlas combines bulk and single-cell thymoma RNA-seq, but raw participant data are deposited in controlled JGA study JGAS000482. Public source data do not expose a reusable tumor-level expression matrix linked to individual time-to-event outcomes.

The ASCO abstract analyzes whole-transcriptome FFPE profiles and OS in a 107-patient Caris thymic-epithelial-tumor cohort, with TCGA-THYM as the second cohort. The external Caris expression, pathology and claims-linked survival records are proprietary and no public patient-level matrix or endpoint table is released; the only openly reusable cohort is TCGA itself.

The meeting abstract reports spatial multi-omics and bulk RNA-seq of resected thymic carcinomas but does not state a patient count, repository accession or individual outcome table. Without a public reusable expression matrix and exact time/status records, eligibility cannot be established.

Five public MET500 RNA libraries collapse to three deterministic THYM patients, below the ten-patient minimum. The public UCSC Xena phenotype matrix contains no exact individual endpoint duration or event/censor indicator; richer participant attributes remain permission-gated in dbGaP.

Treehouse contains one non-TCGA PolyA thymic-carcinoma donor and one RiboD thymoma donor, both without an exact public endpoint. St. Jude does not offer outcome or survival annotations, the current GDC target cohort is TCGA-derived, and Hartwig and PedcBioPortal require controlled or authenticated access. No eligible external THYM cohort was recovered.
candidates.source: Treehouse / St. Jude Cloud / NCI GDC / Hartwig / PedcBioPortal

candidates.review_note: The current CCDI-MCI case inventory registers one thymic carcinoma and one thymoma. Neither case has an open GDC gene-expression file or an exact individual time/status endpoint, and the complete non-TCGA GDC expression inventory contains no Thymic Epithelial Neoplasms files.
candidates.source: NCI GDC / CCDI Molecular Characterization Initiative

candidates.review_note: The DDBJ GEA release contains ten Visium spatial sections: two thymic-hyperplasia sections and eight thymoma sections, including repeated sections from one specimen. It is spatial transcriptomics rather than direct whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq, does not establish ten independent patients and provides no individual time-to-event endpoint.
candidates.source: DDBJ Genomic Expression Archive / thymoma spatial-transcriptomics study

candidates.review_note: KCG labels this mixed thyroid-cancer/thymoma project as RNA-seq and lists 444 biosamples, but every biosample on the project page is restricted. Public metadata do not identify an open disease-specific thymoma expression cohort with exact individual time/status outcomes.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

candidates.review_note: KCG tags this mixed liver-cancer/thymoma RNA-seq project as 160 samples in the project table while its detail page lists 524 biosamples. All listed biosamples are restricted and the public schema exposes no individual survival, recurrence or progression duration/status.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

candidates.review_note: KCG labels this 632-biospecimen RNA-seq project as thymoma in repository metadata, but its own description says refractory thyroid cancer. All biosamples are restricted, target assignment is internally inconsistent and no exact public time-to-event endpoint is exposed.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

candidates.review_note: The KCG project table labels eight RNA-seq samples as thymoma but identifies the tissue source only as adjacent normal. The record is below ten, is not a direct tumor cohort and provides no individual time-to-event endpoint.
candidates.source: Korean Cancer Genomics / Korea BioData Station

cancers.review_note: No independent open bulk RNA-seq thymic-neoplasm cohort with at least ten endpoint-complete patients was identified. The additional pan-cancer and institutional-portal audits found only two META-PRISM, four POG570, three MET500 and isolated Treehouse thymic donors; PCAWG has none. A recent 107-patient Caris whole-transcriptome survival cohort is proprietary, and other recent bulk/spatial studies expose neither a public matrix nor individual survival time.

candidates.review_note: The ten records are sorted T-cell single-cell RNA-seq or TCR-seq libraries from only three endometrial-cancer patients after neoadjuvant pembrolizumab. They are not direct whole-tumor bulk profiles and remain below the patient minimum.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / neoadjuvant endometrial pembrolizumab trial

candidates.review_note: All thirteen direct tumor profiles are Ewing sarcomas. The study appeared in the endometrial search inventory through nonspecific terminology but contains no uterine endometrial carcinoma.

The case-control cohort publishes seven recurrence and 54 non-recurrence labels with full RNA-seq, but no individual recurrence or censoring times. The article states that the underlying clinical data are not publicly available.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / International Journal of Molecular Sciences supplement

candidates.review_note: The mixed 52-tumor release contains one endometrial-carcinoma profile. The UCEC-matched subset is below the ten-patient minimum and GEO provides no individual time-to-event endpoint.

The study RNA-sequences purified circulating monocytes and tumor-associated macrophages from endometrial and breast cancer cases. It does not provide direct whole-tumor UCEC bulk RNA-seq, and outcome associations are evaluated in external tumor cohorts.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / breast and endometrial monocyte-macrophage atlas

candidates.review_note: The release compares 64 EIN or early endometrial-cancer profiles with implantation-failure and control endometrium for a receptivity study. It provides no individual cancer survival or recurrence time/status.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / endometrial receptivity triad study

candidates.review_note: All 20 profiles are EIF4G2-knockdown and control experiments in CD133-sorted HEC-1A endometrial-cancer cells. Patient prognosis is evaluated externally; the accession contains no direct patient tumors.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / HEC-1A EIF4G2 perturbation study

candidates.review_note: All 16 libraries are heterologous LINC01016 overexpression or control experiments in HEK293 cells. The accession contains no endometrial-cancer patient tumor or linked clinical endpoint.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / HEK293 LINC01016 perturbation study

candidates.review_note: Both source-defined UCS patients link to the public META-PRISM TPM matrix and exact OS, but the subset contains only two patients, both events and no censored observations.
candidates.source: META-PRISM / Gustave Roussy cBioPortal and public data release

candidates.review_note: POG570 contains five uterine-carcinosarcoma patients with continuous mRNA expression and exact OS. The subset is below ten patients and all five observations are deaths, so it also fails the censoring threshold.
The complete public PCAWG expression inventory and linked clinical tables were screened by disease label. No uterine-carcinosarcoma patient has a profile in the 1,209-sample expression matrix.

Processed RNA-seq is public for 85 JFCR uterine carcinosarcomas and the primary article analyzes survival, but exhaustive review of GEO and all ten official supplementary/source objects found no individual follow-up time/status table. A 2024 secondary article describes the accession inconsistently as 75 endometrial-stromal-sarcoma cases and reports OS/PFS analyses without a sample crosswalk or row-level endpoint; its associated Zenodo 13946278 deposit is restricted and exposes no public files. Neither source permits deterministic endpoint recovery.

EGA lists paired carcinoma and sarcoma RNA-seq components from 20 gynecologic carcinosarcoma patients, mixing uterine and ovarian primaries. All sequence files require data-access approval, and the public article and supplements do not provide an unrestricted complete expression matrix linked to exact individual time/event records or a deterministic eligible UCS subset.
candidates.source: European Genome-phenome Archive / Cancer Research Communications

candidates.review_note: The AACR abstract describes SMARTer bulk RNA-seq of 251 carcinoma, sarcoma or mixed sectors from 35 uterine and ovarian carcinosarcomas. It provides no repository accession, public complete matrix, disease-specific patient crosswalk or individual time-to-event table, so neither reusable UCS expression nor endpoint eligibility can be verified.
candidates.source: AACR Annual Meeting 2026 / gynecologic carcinosarcoma sector study

candidates.review_note: The diverse-ancestry UCS atlas profiles 13 primary tumors and two matched metastases by 10x single-cell RNA-seq, with bulk whole-genome sequencing rather than bulk RNA expression. The manuscript also states that the single-cell deposit will become available only upon acceptance. It fails the direct whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq contract independently of endpoint availability.
candidates.source: bioRxiv / PubMed Central UCS single-cell atlas

candidates.review_note: The study summarizes T-cell receptor repertoires from 59 uterine and eight ovarian carcinosarcomas into eight pooled GEO records. GEO classifies the experiment as Other and the libraries were assayed on Illumina MiSeq for immune-repertoire profiling, not whole-transcriptome gene expression. The release therefore cannot provide individual tumor expression vectors or meet the 10,000-symbol requirement.
candidates.source: NCBI GEO / uterine and ovarian carcinosarcoma TCR-repertoire study

candidates.review_note: The project has 20 uterine-carcinosarcoma donors. A complete audit of its 287 public Release 28 objects found copy-number, clinical, methylation-array and somatic-mutation roles but no exp_seq object, so no direct bulk RNA-seq matrix can be reconstructed.
The RACGAP1 discovery series collected 14 UCS cases, but only six tumor RNA-seq profiles are publicly available.
Clinical outcomes are available, but transcript expression was measured by Affymetrix microarray rather than RNA-seq.
The 26-patient cohort has follow-up, but only five tumors passed RNA-seq QC and patient-level data remain request-only.
The project registers 80 carcinosarcoma diagnoses but exposes no transcriptome-profiling files that can form an external bulk RNA-seq release.
The uterine-carcinosarcoma study uses single-cell RNA-seq and includes only six tumors, so it fails both the bulk-assay and patient-count criteria.

The RNA-seq and ATAC-seq libraries are gynecologic cancer cell-line experiments, including uterine-carcinosarcoma models JHUCS-1 and SNU-685. No direct patient-tumor bulk RNA-seq or linked time-to-event cohort is present.
The project contains patient-derived xenografts, organoids and tumor-cell cultures from the NCI PDMR rather than direct patient tumor transcriptomes.

The independent 14-sample test set contains mixed mucinous cancers without individual time-to-event outcomes and is not a disease-specific UCS cohort. UCS expression used to train the classifier came from TCGA and is therefore not independent.
The RNA-seq profiles are ANXA2 knockdown and control experiments in the FU-MMT-1 uterine-carcinosarcoma cell line, not direct patient tumors.

The prospective whole-transcriptome study sequenced five uterine carcinosarcomas and three matched adjacent tissues. It is below the ten-patient minimum and does not release an individual time-to-event endpoint.

The series is single-cell RNA-seq from ovarian tumors rather than direct bulk RNA-seq. Its malignant mixed Müllerian tumor material represents two ovarian sites from one patient, so it also fails disease matching and the ten-patient minimum for UCS.
The linked 2026 projects use single-cell RNA-seq and include only five uterine-carcinosarcoma tumors; the remaining samples are ovarian carcinosarcoma or healthy endometrium.
The 22-patient Johns Hopkins uterine-carcinosarcoma study exposes mutation, copy-number and structural-variant profiles in cBioPortal but no RNA-expression profile.

The bulk RNA-seq subseries contains only three uterine-carcinosarcoma tissues selected to derive a carcinoma-associated gene set. It is a methods experiment without a ten-patient cohort or individual time-to-event endpoint.

The series is matched single-cell RNA-seq and single-cell ATAC-seq from eleven mixed endometrial or ovarian tumors. It is neither direct bulk RNA-seq nor a disease-matched uterine-carcinosarcoma survival cohort.

The 53 uterine serous carcinomas and 43 uterine carcinosarcomas were profiled in an FFPE subset with the targeted NanoString PanCancer IO 360 panel rather than whole-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq. The assay cannot satisfy the 10,000-symbol repository contract.

The 81-case high-grade endometrial-carcinoma study includes 21 uterine carcinosarcomas profiled by whole-transcriptome RNA-seq. Raw sequencing is deposited under controlled Japanese Genotype-phenotype Archive access, while other generated data are available only on request; no public reusable UCS expression matrix linked to exact individual time/event records is released.
candidates.source: Cancer Research Communications / Japanese Genotype-phenotype Archive

candidates.review_note: All patient-level transcriptomic and survival findings were computed from TCGA-UCS. The independent experimental work used MES-SA and SK-UT-1 uterine-sarcoma cell lines and did not release direct UCS tumor RNA-seq with individual follow-up.
candidates.source: American Journal of Cancer Research / GTSF1 study

candidates.review_note: The 71-sample uterine-sarcoma RNA-seq cohort contains 47 endometrial stromal sarcomas, 18 leiomyosarcomas, three adenosarcomas, one other tumor and only two carcinosarcomas. The disease-matched UCS subset is therefore below the ten-patient minimum.
candidates.source: National Genomics Data Center / uterine sarcoma cohort

candidates.review_note: The study performed whole-transcriptome RNA-seq on macro-dissected carcinoma and sarcoma components from ten UCS patients. The article and three public supplements provide histology, figures and mutation results but no reusable complete expression matrix or individual survival, recurrence or progression time/status.
candidates.source: Gynecologic Oncology / Avera UCS component study

candidates.review_note: The 168 de-identified UCS tumors were evaluated with IHC, targeted 592-gene DNA sequencing and an RNA fusion assay. The study does not provide whole-transcriptome expression or an openly reusable patient-level expression-plus-endpoint release.
candidates.source: Caris Life Sciences / UCS molecular-profiling series

candidates.review_note: No public MET500 RNA row is labeled UCS. Thirty-nine MISC patients cannot be deterministically assigned to uterine carcinosarcoma from the unrestricted phenotype fields, and the public UCSC Xena matrix supplies no exact individual endpoint in any case.

All 57 Treehouse PolyA uterine-carcinosarcoma donors are TCGA-UCS duplicates and the RiboD compendium has none. The current GDC inventory adds only TCGA-UCS and two uterine-site HCMI cancer models rather than direct patient survival records; Hartwig and PedcBioPortal require controlled or authenticated access. No eligible external UCS cohort was recovered.

GOG-0261 provides patient-level clinical and outcome data for 449 eligible uterine-carcinosarcoma patients. The NCTN release, primary report and targeted translational follow-up search expose no matched whole-tumor bulk RNA-seq matrix or molecular accession using the same patient identifiers. Clinical follow-up alone cannot satisfy the expression-plus-endpoint contract.
candidates.source: NCI NCTN/NCORP Data Archive / NRG Oncology

candidates.accession: NCI-MATCH current GDC RNA inventory:MATCH-N-B5TI; MATCH-Z1D-B44D; MATCH-Z1D-B44E
candidates.review_note: Three carcinosarcoma cases have public STAR-count files across MATCH-N and MATCH-Z1D. The subset is below ten patients, spans separate biomarker-selected treatment arms, and GDC exposes neither a usable individual survival duration/status nor recurrence duration/status.

The participant-level GraphQL audit found two disease-matched uterine-carcinosarcoma participants in HTAN phs002371, represented by 14 samples and 68 controlled RNA-seq file records. The disease subset is below ten patients, all sequence files are controlled, and no public exact individual time/status endpoint is exposed. It cannot close the UCS evidence gap.

cancers.review_note: The principal public uterine/ovarian carcinosarcoma RNA-seq series includes linked outcomes in the publication analysis but does not release individual time/status. The additional pan-cancer and institutional-portal audits found only two META-PRISM and five POG570 UCS cases; PCAWG and MET500 have none, while Treehouse and GDC only cross-index TCGA-UCS or models. Recent multi-sector and paired-component bulk cohorts are unreleased or controlled and mix uterine with ovarian primaries; a new 13-patient atlas is single-cell rather than bulk.

candidates.review_note: The RNA-seq component contains Mel270 uveal-melanoma cell perturbations and HUVEC exosomal RNA, with additional cell-line chromatin assays. Clinical survival correlations use external datasets; no direct uveal-melanoma patient cohort is deposited.

candidates.expression_unit: log2(CPM + 1) derived from pinned featureCounts files
candidates.review_note: The SDRF links exactly 74 count files to the 74 tumor identifiers in Supplementary Table 1, and all 74 endpoint-complete patients are retained. DFD and DFO are OS events; NED and AWD are censored. There are no additional tumor count files or omitted endpoint-complete patients in E-MTAB-4097.

The Korean uveal-melanoma cohort links clinical follow-up to 40 primary tumors, but the deposited molecular assay is whole-genome sequencing of tumor-normal pairs. It contains no bulk RNA-expression matrix and cannot expand the transcriptomic repository.
candidates.source: European Genome-Phenome Archive / Experimental & Molecular Medicine

candidates.review_note: The paired primary/metastatic cohort reports survival but uses the targeted HTG EdgeSeq panel with about 2,570 features, below the 10,000-gene minimum.

Supplementary Table 1 provides exact OS time and status for all 19 metastatic uveal-melanoma RNA-seq patients. The public workbook releases only clinical rows, Hallmark definitions, model summaries and differential-expression statistics; it does not contain the per-patient 14,307-gene expression matrix or cite an open sequencing accession. The cohort also has only one censored patient.
candidates.source: Alliance A091201 phase-II trial / PMC supplement

candidates.review_note: The PEMDAC phase-II trial enrolled 29 metastatic uveal-melanoma patients and generated pretreatment bulk RNA-seq for 20 tumors passing quality control. The 22 RNA-seq files catalogued by EGA are restricted under EGAD00001007912, while public source data do not provide a complete patient-level expression matrix linked to exact OS or PFS time/status.

The 2026 organotropism study aggregates whole-exome, whole-genome and targeted-DNA cohorts and reports clinical survival, including a 135-patient primary-tumor validation cohort. It does not contribute a direct bulk RNA-seq expression cohort and therefore cannot expand the transcriptomic repository.
candidates.source: npj Precision Oncology / Yale uveal-melanoma organotropism study

candidates.review_note: The study profiles 100 metastases from 84 patients by bulk total RNA-seq. Raw transcriptomes are restricted in dbGaP, and the 18 public supplementary data tables plus source-data archive do not expose a complete patient-level expression matrix with exact survival time/status.

The trial generated 141 baseline and longitudinal metastatic uveal-melanoma bulk RNA-seq biopsies and reports gene-outcome associations. De-identified RNA-seq files are available only through controlled EGA access, so no openly redistributable expression-and-endpoint release can be built.
The metastatic uveal-melanoma immunotherapy trial enrolled nine RNA-profiled patients, below the patient minimum.
Metastasis-free survival is linked, but the assay is an Affymetrix U133 Plus 2.0 expression array.
The cohort is single-cell RNA-seq from six primary tumors, below the patient minimum and outside the bulk-RNA policy.
The series contains ten direct bulk RNA-seq profiles from uveal-melanoma metastases, but GEO and the associated publication do not provide individual survival or progression time/status.

Four primary and six metastatic uveal-melanoma tumors were measured with a targeted NanoString panel of 737 immune genes. The study is classified as expression profiling by array and is below the 10,000-symbol requirement.
This SuperSeries combines expression and methylation microarrays from FFPE uveal melanomas. It is not a direct bulk RNA-seq cohort.

The expression subseries contains four early-metastasis and four non-metastatic FFPE uveal melanomas profiled by microarray. It fails the assay requirement, the ten-patient minimum and unbiased cohort ascertainment.
The direct bulk RNA-seq release contains baseline and longitudinal biopsies from only nine metastatic uveal-melanoma patients. The number of unique patients is below the prespecified minimum of ten.

Thirteen primary and ten matched metastatic uveal-melanoma profiles were measured with the targeted HTG EdgeSeq Oncology Biomarker Panel covering 2,549 transcripts. The release fails the 10,000-symbol whole-transcriptome requirement.

Twenty direct uveal-melanoma tumors have short-read whole-transcriptome profiles, with long-read profiles for 18 matched cases. The now-published Scientific Data resource focuses on isoform discovery and AlphaFold structures. GEO exposes only case number, tissue and disease identity, while the article and its deposited files contain no individual survival, metastasis or recurrence time/status. The expression cohort therefore remains unusable for time-to-event analysis.

The SuperSeries includes human tumor methylation arrays, but its RNA-seq subseries GSE130356 contains only six BAP1-perturbation libraries from 92.1 and Mel202 cell lines. It provides no direct patient-tumor RNA-seq cohort.

The study RNA-profiled liver metastases from 28 uveal-melanoma and 38 cutaneous-melanoma patients. The sequence release is available only after institutional review and a data-access agreement, and no open patient-level expression-plus-time-to-event bundle is provided.
candidates.source: European Genome-Phenome Archive / melanoma liver-metastasis comparison

candidates.review_note: Twenty-eight metastatic uveal-melanoma tumors underwent bulk RNA-seq, but the whole-genome, exome and RNA files are restricted in EGA. Public figures and supplements do not provide a complete matrix with individual survival or progression time/status.
candidates.source: European Genome-Phenome Archive / metastatic UVM driver study

candidates.review_note: The RNA-seq experiment consists of total and polysomal RNA after EIF1AX knockdown in 92.1, Omm2.3 and Omm1 cell lines. Patient sequencing in dbGaP does not provide an open direct tumor expression cohort with linked time-to-event follow-up.

Patient sequencing used to study SF3B1-mutated cancers is restricted in dbGaP. Public code and intermediate files do not expose an independent uveal-melanoma whole-transcriptome matrix linked to individual survival, metastasis or recurrence time/status.

cancers.review_note: E-MTAB-4097 provides a fully public independent primary-uveal-melanoma RNA-seq cohort with one count profile and explicit overall-survival follow-up per patient.

candidates.review_note: FU-GBC supplies 135 primary-tumor RNA profiles, 66 matched adjacent non-cancerous profiles and individual survival month/status fields. The source does not explicitly define survival time zero. The article is all-rights-reserved, so TRACE disables matrix redistribution.

cancers.review_note: FU-GBC is represented as an external-only gallbladder cancer cohort; it is not mapped to TCGA-CHOL.

candidates.review_note: TRACE retains one deterministic pretreatment RNA profile per untreated CLL patient. The release also exposes source-defined failure-free survival (361 events, 205 censures).

cancers.review_note: CLL is represented as an external-only hematologic cohort and is not mapped to a TCGA solid-tumor project.

candidates.review_note: The GSE49711 gene matrix is linked deterministically to GSE62564 outcomes for the same 498 primary neuroblastomas. GSE49710 and the transcript-level release are overlapping representations, not independent cohorts.

cancers.review_note: NBL is represented as one external-only SEQC cohort; prior treatment at sampling remains unknown rather than being inferred.

candidates.review_note: TRACE restricts the source study to PLGG primary, treatment-naive tumors. The source DFS field encompasses disease recurrence or progression and is labelled accordingly; OS is not exposed because only one death is observed.
candidates.source: cBioPortal DataHub / CPTAC pediatric brain tumors

cancers.review_note: PLGG is represented as an external-only primary, treatment-naive subset of the CPTAC pediatric brain-tumor study.

candidates.review_note: The release contains only primary SCLC tumors sampled before chemotherapy. Seven normal lungs, eight postchemotherapy patients and one ambiguously duplicated patient are not pooled or used as fallback.

cancers.review_note: SCLC is represented as an external-only, surgically resected treatment-naive cohort; this ascertainment limits generalization to all SCLC presentations.
